items.title: Church Gathering
items.description: Our weekly gathering as a church family — worship, teaching from God’s Word, and space to pause, reflect, and praise.

items.title: Cadre
items.description: Cadres are designed to help people build authentic relationships, grow in their faith, and walk through life together — opening God’s Word, reflecting on Sunday’s sermon, and praying for one another.

items.title: Bread
items.description: Want to grow in reading God’s Word? At Bread we walk through a book of the Bible together and provide a reading plan for the month ahead. Come ready to learn, grow, and be nourished.

items.title: Selah Youth
items.description: Middle and high schoolers growing in faith through worship, teaching, fellowship, and fun — helping students deepen their relationship with God and find a sense of belonging and purpose.

items.title: Prayer Room
items.description: A monthly evening set aside to pray together — space to be still, listen, and pray for our church, our city, and one another.

items.title: Shabbat Dinner
items.description: A monthly dinner expression of Selah Church — cultivating relationships within the church family and honoring the Sabbath around real tables in real homes.
